description: Road Centrelines is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Open Data. This is the result of an initiative of the ACT Government, with support from Geoscience Australia, to create a 'single point of truth' road, track and trail data set for the ACT and its immediate region. Data was brought together from a range of existing custodians and combined to provide a single authoritative data set. Coverage: ACT Government Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Open Data. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
